runtime_implementation.scope: Matrix Top 11 command adapters: Duplicate (in place), Edit/Control Points On with F10, Mirror/Move/Rotate with point prompts, Explode/Join/Split/Trim and the shared toolbar availability state. Ring Rail remains deferred to M04.
remaining: Manual M03-UI acceptance of the Top 11 toolbar, prompts and grip drag is pending; the implementer does not self-sign it.
Duplicate has no copy option beyond Vertical/From Last Point/Use Last Distance/Use Last Direction.
Surface edit grips are an OM9 extension rather than Rhino/Matrix parity; they do not reparameterise the surface.
The no-default developer build refuses a BRep cutter; the product default uses exact OCCT faces.
The toolbar Mirror starts with the two-point vertical plane; typing 3Point switches to the arbitrary plane.
BRep mirror needs the occt-brep feature (product default).
Ring Rail is deferred to M04 (no M03 L4).
